draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks again for the kickoff call last week. On your dark mode question, your ticket is still open with support — dark mode isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and they'll follow up in that thread.

In the meantime, the usual first step is getting a project set up: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
